You have learned to supercharge your attacks with your ki making your attacks hit with unearthly force. Wearing Armor does not affect this Feature. You gain the following benefits when unarmed:

  • You can use a d4 in place of your Unarmed Strike's Damage Die. This die increases as you gain Blaster Levels, as shown on the table above. You may use Wisdom as your Modifier for Unarmed Strikes.
  • Your Basic Ki Blast Damage Die increases as you gain Blaster Levels, as shown on the table above.
